name: Ruth Castellano
blurb: The Hard Case: kills first, trusts last, calls a vote early and means it.

voice.direction: Woman in her forties, gravel alto, flat and blunt, short words.

portrait.direction: Cropped dark hair, scar through one eyebrow, surplus army coat, tire iron across her knees.

turn.start.text: My turn. Stay out of the way.

crisis.prevented.text: Good. Don't make me count on you twice.

crisis.failed.text: That's not bad luck. That's a hand on the scale.

vote.lean.no.text: No. {seat} hasn't earned the boot yet.

exposure.bite.text: {survivor} is down. Keep the line tight.

morale.low.text: We're nearly dead. Act like it matters.
One more bad round and it's over. Think.

game.lost.text: That's the winter. It always wins eventually.

notes: Original persona. Lines written in our own words for M4.
